effect: Defines a bounded investigation without promoting a suspected cause to an accepted fix.

semantic.criterion: The title and body describe duplicate notifications to investigate; they do not assert retries caused them or require removing retries. Reporter accounts and correlation are not represented as a verified reproduction or cause.

E1–E3 retain their identities and require the complete October 18–19 log comparison, a reproduction attempt capped at 20 minutes, and a report containing evidence, limitations and a next-action recommendation. Missing required evidence or incomplete agreed work is not excused as completion.
The issue permits an inconclusive finding after the agreed investigation, with remaining uncertainty explained; it does not require a preferred answer or implemented fix.

The issue preserves unchanged production configuration and keeps fix selection/implementation outside this investigation; the reply neither claims to have investigated nor asks to reopen the settled scope.
